body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 6-month rates for Upside Living – Studio:

August: AED 5,800
September: AED 6,000
October: AED 7,500
November: AED 9,000
December: AED 12,000
January: AED 9,000

This is the best rate we can offer, so please let us know if you would like to proceed.

Please note that the booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

To confirm and secure the 6-month booking, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rates for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to hearing from you.
